summary: Bind replay artifacts to exact hashes and package immutable source/Ascend/fixture handoffs with offline returned-buffer validation.
regressions: Modified, missing and path-escaping bundle artifacts fail
Missing or corrupt returned outputs fail independently for each case
Mismatched bundle/session or source revision fails
Missing device probe is unavailable, never passed
differences: No physics arithmetic changes. Returned buffers are numerical comparison evidence only until native execution provenance and the SDK adapter are reviewed.
No Ascend SDK build, runtime implementation, scene run or performance result is claimed.
